purpose: Teach: 杉山/土井/松尾/大石/杉浦/小坂/田原/赤松

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの杉山と話してたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you talking to Sugiyama from the next class.
lines.style: Light accusation, playful. Lean in like catching him in something small. Warm teasing, not mean. Quick pace on the observation, slight smile underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家庭科で土井善晴先生のレシピ使ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were using Doi Shigeharu's recipes in home ec, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry counter-accusation. Not defensive — matching her teasing energy with his own. Slight lift at the end, turning it back on her. Calm, almost amused.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、国語で松尾芭蕉の俳句覚えたろ
lines.en: Riku, you memorized Matsuo Bashō's haiku in Japanese literature.
lines.style: Escalating the game. Faster now, building momentum. Playful challenge in her voice, like she's collecting evidence. Small satisfaction at catching something real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で大石内蔵助の話聞いたろ、桜
lines.en: You listened to the story about Oishi Kuranosuke in social studies, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Matching her escalation. Quieter confidence now — he's not rushing. Each observation lands. Slight knowing tone, like he's been watching her too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、漫画の杉浦日向子のエッセイ読んでたな
lines.en: Riku, you were reading Sugiura Hinako's essays about manga.
lines.style: Wry shift. Faster again, almost breathless with the gathering proof. Sarcastic edge creeping in — she's enjoying this. Light mockery underneath the warmth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、合唱コンクールで小坂明子の曲歌ったろ、桜
lines.en: You sang Kosaka Akiko's song in the choir competition, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Steady, deliberate. He's not rushing anymore. Slight warmth returning under the observation — almost affectionate in how precisely he's noticed. Calm finish.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、田原俊彦のドラマ再放送見てたな
lines.en: Riku, you were watching reruns of the Tahara Toshihiko drama.
lines.style: Quick, sharp, almost triumphant. Wry amusement at having found something embarrassing. Breathless on the final word. The sarcasm is affectionate — she's delighted with what she's found.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、林間学校で赤松林歩いたろ、桜
lines.en: You walked through the Akamatsu forest on the field camp, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet and close. Gentle observation, not accusation anymore. The game is winding down. Warm, almost intimate in how carefully he's noticed. Soft landing on her name.
